result.title: Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion
result.summary: Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels. UNITE recently merged the first two into a single generative encoder trained in one stage, but its decoder remains a separate network. We ask whether this last network can be folded in too, so that one diffusion transformer encodes, generates, and decodes. Simply letting the shared backbone decode does not help. What makes it work is to cast all three modes as position-aligned sequence maps over one fully shared backbone, distinguished only by a mode token and the timestep. The resulting model, UNIFIED, is simple: one network trained from scratch in a single stage with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO). On ImageNet-1K 256x256 at matched parameters, UNIFIED improves gFID over UNITE at three sizes (~60M, ~115M, and ~215M) and reaches 2.08 with 215M parameters, the lowest among compared models under 250M parameters. On text-to-image generation, UNIFIED-B (218M) reaches a GenEval score of 0.87 at 512x512, exceeding single-stage pixel diffusion models with around one billion parameters. Full unification of latent diffusion is thus not merely feasible but beneficial.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 UNIFIED，把像素编码器、latent 生成器和解码器折叠为同一个 diffusion transformer：三种模式统一为位置对齐的序列映射，仅靠 mode token 与时间步区分，并用重建损失与 flow-matching 损失单阶段从零训练，在 ImageNet-1K 与文本到图像生成上取得优于 UNITE 的 gFID 和 GenEval 分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属图像生成，与 VLM 推理无直接关联；但「单一共享 backbone 由 mode token 切换编码、迭代生成、解码」的模式条件化共享状态设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据编码与 latent 推理状态更新是否共用同一网络提供可核查的结构线索。
